title: Session, where.
bodyText: The intermediate appellate court shall sit in Honolulu; provided that the chief judge may appoint a different place for the sitting of the court, pro tempore.
bodyHtml: [§602-54]  Session, where.  The intermediate appellate court shall sit in Honolulu; provided that the chief judge may appoint a different place for the sitting of the court, pro tempore. [L 1979, c 111, pt of §3]
